string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261124000_whats_new
string-array.item: In-app updates: when a new version is available, download and install it right inside the app instead of going through the browser. Downloads fall back to mirrors automatically, and the package signature is verified against the installed version before installing
New App updates page in Settings with a manual update check and an auto-check switch

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261124000_changes
string-array.item: Update checks are more reliable: when the GitHub API is rate-limited or unreachable, the app falls back to mirrors and the release page redirect
The source repository is now public: https://github.com/gurio-wine/Gusic

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261013014_changes
string-array.item: Heartbeat mode pulls far less data while filling the queue: Liked Songs are sampled by id instead of downloading the whole playlist, and each batch reuses the recommendation page itself for song details instead of a second request per batch, which also speeds up queue building

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261013013_changes
string-array.item: Heartbeat mode now builds its queue with far less data: each batch trims the full recommendation page to just the requested 0-5 tracks and drops anything already queued or reserved as a seed before fetching song details

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101312_changes
string-array.item: The notification’s repeat-mode button now shows the same cardiology icon as the player while Heartbeat mode is active, instead of a generic heart

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101311_changes
string-array.item: Heartbeat queue cap now actually holds: the server ignores the per-batch count request and returns full pages, so batches are trimmed locally to the requested 0-5 tracks — the queue now stops within a few tracks of 150 instead of running to 200

Heartbeat recommendations no longer pull in tracks from your own playlist or Liked Songs ahead of their turn, so seeds land in their shuffled order and the queue keeps the seed-then-a-few-picks rhythm
The notification repeat-mode button now shows a heart icon while Heartbeat mode is active, and tapping it exits back to order playback

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101310_changes
string-array.item: Heartbeat batches now honor the requested 0-5 track size: the count was sent in a form the server ignored, so a single batch could return dozens of tracks and throw off the queue cap and the seed pacing
Each Heartbeat batch now lands in the queue before the next one is generated, keeping the seed-then-recommendations structure in strict order
Heartbeat mode now plays through the queue in order — a finished track moves on to the next one instead of repeating
Entering or leaving Heartbeat mode no longer makes the album carousel flash: pages keep their identity across queue changes and the carousel no longer jumps between full-width and peek layouts

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101309_changes
string-array.item: Fixed Heartbeat mode never actually replacing the queue: the shuffle-off reorder was racing the queue clear and restoring the old playlist
Entering and leaving Heartbeat mode no longer rebuilds the playback queue — the current track is no longer re-prepared, so playback, progress and lyrics continue seamlessly
Repeat-mode cycle is now Order, Shuffle, One, Heartbeat, so Heartbeat is always entered from a non-shuffled queue and restoring keeps the original order

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101308_whats_new
string-array.item: The player adds a Heartbeat repeat mode for Netease tracks: it keeps the current song playing, then keeps growing a queue of similar picks seeded from your playlist and Liked Songs, up to 150 tracks
Leaving Heartbeat mode restores your original playlist around the song you’re on — playback never pauses on the way in or out

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101307_whats_new
string-array.item: Liked-songs recommendations now gather from several seed tracks and merge the results, so the list is no longer stuck at a handful of songs

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101306_whats_new
string-array.item: Kuwo login is now SMS verification only, and it signs the native session that reads your own playlists
Fixed Kuwo playlists failing instantly: the load request was never sent out, so you never saw a loading state — it now actually loads over the network

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101306_changes
string-array.item: Switching back to the Netease page no longer flashes a full refresh; each platform home is cached per source and shown instantly
Netease recommendations are now simply hidden when not logged in, instead of showing a login prompt
Removed the floating shuffle and play-all buttons from playlist, charts and recommendation pages

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101305_whats_new
string-array.item: Kuwo login now offers SMS verification: pick SMS or QR code in the login dialog — the SMS path signs the native session that reads your own playlists, fixing tracks failing to load
Discover platform pages now loop when you swipe past the edge
The Discover header now follows your finger: platform name and account chip switch while swiping, no longer waiting for the page to settle

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101305_changes
string-array.item: The Netease page no longer lands on charts: it shows the login prompt first, and recommendations once logged in
Kuwo native requests now register a device identity and follow the official client construction for playlist reading

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v010_whats_new
string-array.item: Added a Discover page to enable online features.

Split online and local entries: online pages perform online operations only, local pages perform local operations only. Tracks played from an online platform are attributed to the local platform but not stored offline; local operations remain available.
Added playlist import/export for LX Music.
Added custom music source and script import for LX Music.
Added song download for LX Music.
Added audio quality selection for LX Music.
Added login for LX Music.
Added playback caching for LX Music.
Added mini player lyrics display during song playback.
Added lyrics on the player page.
Added song sharing.
Added Traditional Chinese language.
More to explore on your own...

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v010_changes
string-array.item: Local search page is now hidden and disabled by default.
LRCLIB online lyrics are enabled by default and removed from first-launch selection; search no longer auto-selects the first result.
Theme style now follows the system by default.
Library navigation style selection has been removed from first-launch selection.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v011_whats_new
string-array.item: Adjusted the player page layout.
Added an in-app update checker to the About page.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v011_changes
string-array.item: Fixed a race condition when switching between multiple online sources.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261008_whats_new
string-array.item: The local library now imports music through the system file picker (SAF) instead of MediaStore scanning; imported files persist across restarts.
QQ Music login now supports web login in addition to QR code login.
App identity, name, and icons are now Gusic throughout.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261008_changes
string-array.item: Playlist export files now carry a Gusic playlist marker; old PixelPlayer exports still import.
Internal cleanup and documentation updates after the development-tooling migration.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261010_whats_new
string-array.item: QQ Music login now loads your profile, liked songs, and playlists after signing in.
Online platform names are now shown in full (QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou Music, Kuwo Music) instead of abbreviations.
The About page header icon now matches the new Gusic branding.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261010_changes
string-array.item: Released APKs are named gusic-<abi>-[v<version>].apk.
Platform login cookies are excluded from cloud backup and device transfer.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261011_whats_new
string-array.item: About page header now shows the app icon foreground style.
All platforms are listed directly on the account login page.
QQ Music login opens the web page login directly.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261011_changes
string-array.item: Discover now defaults to QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou, Kuwo order.
Platforms can be hidden in the reorder sheet; logged-out ones are hidden by default and QQ Music always stays visible.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101101_whats_new
string-array.item: Tapping any song in a playlist or chart now queues the whole list in order and starts from that song
Fixed QQ Music search returning no results
Fixed QQ Music account playlists all showing as liked songs

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101101_changes

Default launch tab is now Discover
Library navigation is fixed to compact pill + grid; the tab-row mode and its setting are removed

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101102_whats_new

Play screen now has a single three-mode cycle button: list loop, single loop and shuffle
Cycle and favorite buttons now sit left of the lyrics button with a matching style

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101102_changes
string-array.item: Cycle and favorite controls removed from the lyrics more sheet and the queue sheet
Album cover is now a taller 1:1 square and lower controls moved down
Mini player now shows the artist beside the song title

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101103_whats_new

Playback notification: close button removed, cycle-mode button added in front

Playback notification cycle-mode button stays in front

QQ favorite resolution reinforced: matches by song name and artist before failing
Notification cycle-mode button moved to the very front, before transport controls
Player top bar now shows the colored platform tag instead of "Now Playing"

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101105_changes
string-array.item: "Charts" module button label no longer clipped
Lyrics font scale: 100% now equals the old 70% size, overall smaller
Lyrics alignment defaults to center
Removed the settings entry from the Discover top bar

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101106_whats_new
string-array.item: Player page: expanded layout now wraps its height, all components shift down to close the bottom gap
QQ favorites: requests now carry the web sign; failures show a business code for diagnosis
Playback notification: previous-track button restored, cycle-mode button stays in front
Play/pause button background now matches the cycle-mode button color

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101106_changes
string-array.item: "Show file info" now defaults to off in Settings
Removed the settings entry from the Home top bar
Mine page: Playlists category moved to second
"Charts" module button widened so its label shows in full

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101107_whats_new
string-array.item: QQ favorites: rewritten onto the client protocol endpoint with a new signature, fixing the 80105 rejection
QQ search: requests now carry login state and signature with an automatic retry, far fewer empty results
Notification buttons reordered to previous, play/pause, next, cycle, favorite; previous no longer vanishes in repeat-one
Discover page: "Mine" stays available on every platform, showing a login prompt and entry when signed out

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101107_changes

Player page: play/pause now shares the exact background of the cycle/favorite/lyrics chips
Mine page: icon now matches the Discover "Mine" module; Albums and Artists categories removed

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101108_changes

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101109_whats_new

History: a song jumps to the top the moment it starts playing, no need to finish first
Player page: opening animation no longer jumps at the end; cover is exactly 1:1; more bottom breathing room

Previous-track notification button restored as the native system button, stays visible in repeat-one

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101110_whats_new

Discover: search box moved to a full-width row at the top; only Mine and Charts modules remain

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101201_whats_new
string-array.item: Leaderboards redesigned as a menu grid: two board cards per row, each showing the board name and its top three tracks; tap a card to open the board
The Liked category is now two-level: level one lists this app plus each logged-in platform, level two shows that source’s liked songs; platforms you are not logged into are hidden

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101201_changes
string-array.item: Favoriting and unfavoriting no longer show success toasts; only failures are reported

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101202_whats_new

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101204_changes

Kugou sign-in now states clearly that it needs an account extension instead of failing silently
Lyrics page play/pause button now matches the player page colors

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101205_whats_new

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101205_changes

Kuwo now fetches nickname and avatar after web sign-in
Songs with only plain lyrics open the lyrics page from the preview; songs with no lyrics offer a search-and-import entry there

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101206_whats_new

Cloud streaming (Navidrome and Jellyfin) and ListenBrainz scrobbling have been removed, along with the accounts screen

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101206_changes

Liked tab: signed-in platforms show their song count even at zero, just like this app’s favorites

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101207_whats_new

Kugou playlist list no longer duplicates the auto-managed liked playlist, and collected albums are told apart from playlists

Liked, Playlists and Collections refresh the moment you enter a platform

QQ Music search finds artists and albums again, and artist pages list their songs once more

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101208_changes

Kugou collected albums no longer appear among playlists — the list source flag now tells them apart
The profile strip above Top charts is gone
Chinese labels now say 歌手 where they used to say 艺术家

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101304_whats_new

Switching platforms no longer reloads the charts previews; already-visited pages appear instantly
Kuwo playlist reading now routes by playlist ID size through the native client protocol, so a long ID can no longer silently land on someone else’s list

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101304_changes

Taps on the header platform name and account chip no longer show ripples, and the dropdown arrow beside the platform name is gone
Kuwo login now also collects session cookies from the bare domain and the vip1/i hosts for the native playlist protocol

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101303_whats_new
string-array.item: Discover adds long-and-short indicator bars under the search bar, marking the platform you are on
Fixed Kuwo user playlists failing to load their tracks — now read via the Kuwo app protocol
Tap the platform name in the header to reorder platforms

The account nickname in the header is capped narrower so it crowds the layout less
Charts content now sits further below the search bar

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101302_whats_new

Fixed Kuwo liked songs staying empty, and user playlist tracks failing to load

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101302_changes

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101301_whats_new

Kuwo user playlists arrive — created and collected lists load with their details

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101301_changes

The player page moves the platform badge and like button to the right side
